areas.title: Dynamic analysis and sandbox
areas.goal: Run unknown Windows executables in an isolated, restorable environment and supply usable runtime telemetry.
areas.done_when: Agreed subissues are complete and the component owner confirms integration and verification.

tasks.title: Set up the sandbox environment
tasks.goal: Document a repeatable isolated VM setup and its operating assumptions.
tasks.done_when: Document a repeatable isolated VM setup and its operating assumptions.

tasks.title: Manage execution and restoration
tasks.goal: Provide a controlled sample execution flow and restore a clean snapshot between runs.
tasks.done_when: Provide a controlled sample execution flow and restore a clean snapshot between runs.

tasks.title: Capture runtime activity
tasks.goal: Collect process, registry, filesystem, network-request, and API activity needed by the pipeline.
tasks.done_when: Collect process, registry, filesystem, network-request, and API activity needed by the pipeline.

tasks.title: Export sandbox results
tasks.goal: Provide documented structured logs that the behavioral ML and backend teams can consume.
tasks.done_when: Provide documented structured logs that the behavioral ML and backend teams can consume.

tasks.title: Validate and document sandbox operation
tasks.goal: Record checks of isolation, restoration, failure handling, and telemetry completeness.
tasks.done_when: Record checks of isolation, restoration, failure handling, and telemetry completeness.

areas.title: Machine learning
areas.goal: Provide static and behavioral classification plus reproducible evaluation of the detection layers.
areas.done_when: Agreed subissues are complete and the component owner confirms integration and verification.

tasks.title: Prepare datasets and evaluation splits
tasks.goal: Document dataset preparation, labels, and train/validation/test splits, including withheld families.
tasks.done_when: Document dataset preparation, labels, and train/validation/test splits, including withheld families.

tasks.title: Develop static classification
tasks.goal: Build static feature processing, train a baseline classifier, and expose probability-score inference.
tasks.done_when: Build static feature processing, train a baseline classifier, and expose probability-score inference.

tasks.title: Develop behavioral classification
tasks.goal: Convert runtime logs into features and train/integrate a behavioral classifier.
tasks.done_when: Convert runtime logs into features and train/integrate a behavioral classifier.

tasks.title: Explain model outputs
tasks.goal: Provide feature-importance information and document how scores should be interpreted.
tasks.done_when: Provide feature-importance information and document how scores should be interpreted.

tasks.title: Evaluate detection performance
tasks.goal: Provide reproducible accuracy, precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC, false-positive/negative, and layer-comparison results, including withheld-family evaluation.
tasks.done_when: Provide reproducible accuracy, precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC, false-positive/negative, and layer-comparison results, including withheld-family evaluation.

areas.title: LLM threat analysis

areas.done_when: Agreed subissues are complete and the component owner confirms integration and verification.

tasks.title: Define report inputs and outputs

tasks.done_when: Agree on the telemetry/model fields consumed and the report structure produced.

tasks.title: Generate evidence-grounded explanations
tasks.goal: Produce readable explanations tied to supplied observations rather than unsupported claims.
tasks.done_when: Produce readable explanations tied to supplied observations rather than unsupported claims.

tasks.title: Map findings to MITRE ATT&CK
tasks.goal: Associate supported observations with appropriate tactics/techniques and make uncertainty visible.
tasks.done_when: Associate supported observations with appropriate tactics/techniques and make uncertainty visible.

tasks.title: Provide recommendations

tasks.done_when: Generate appropriate mitigation summaries based on the findings without implementing automatic remediation.

tasks.title: Integrate and evaluate report generation
tasks.goal: Connect the API, handle missing inputs/API failures, and document example-report checks.
tasks.done_when: Connect the API, handle missing inputs/API failures, and document example-report checks.
